notes.title: Police Station Simulator - our new game!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce a new game we’ve been working on for quite a while:

[previewyoutube=zl0sJdtUjII;full][/previewyoutube]

Arm yourself with some coffee and donuts because Police Station Simulator is coming soon!

Bum Simulator never took itself too seriously, and you can expect similar vibes from our newest title as it is set in the "same world", but in a different place - the city of Twin Pigs.

If you enjoyed the adventures in Bumsville, then consider supporting us by [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2155140/Police_Station_Simulator/]adding Police Station Simulator to your wishlist![/url]

notes.title: Update 3.7.12.a

Improvements:

notes.title: Changelist Version 3.6.14.a
notes.notes:
Major:
[list]
[*] Added legend to the map.
[*] Added "silent protagonist" option that disables main character's grunts and mumbles.
[*] You can now decline a timed quest upon entering its trigger.
[*] Lowered the construction cost of end-game buildings and items to limit the grind necessary to get them.
[*] Modified the begging skill and civilian reactions to begging, to make the process more reliable.
[*] Modified the "flip the bird" mechanic to make it more reliable.
[*] Modified the alchemy station mechanics to make them more reliable.
[*] Modified the lamps that you can build in your base - they now look better and provide more light.
[*] Made Dr. W. East sidequests easier by increasing the time limit.
[*] Made Trixie sidequests easier by increasing the size of the area you're restricted to.
[/list]

Minor:
[list]
[*] Added a slider bar to the crafting menu scrollable list.
[*] Adjusted the way Bugs choose which player base to raid.
[*] Better icons to represent both Bug and Creep bases.
[*] Adjusted the number of police officers on the map.
[*] Adjusted AI of the construction workers during the "Lady Justice" quest.
[*] Blocked the ability to fertilize a fully grown plant which caused you to needlessly lose guano.
[*] You get slightly more wood from destructible wooden objects.
[*] Disabled sidequests during missions where starting them would hinder your progress.
[*] Dying during Mr. Jello sidequests now automatically fails the sidequest instead of respawning you with not enough time to finish the mission.
[*] Skill cooldown now resets after death.
[*] You can now build carpets under existing furniture.
[*] Harvested plants now go straight into your hand.
[*] Deconstructing the generator now returns some of the unused fuel.
[*] Added even more quest markers to indicate the current step required in some quests.
[*] You can't sell the battery in pawn shops anymore (sorry speedrunners!)
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed the area of the Peckers skill effect.
[*] Fixed the errors in the Chinese and Russian translations.
[*] Fixed the police taser so it can hit you while you're in your base area.
[*] Fixed the prompts which are displayed when you're in the build mode.
[*] Fixed the bug that let you trigger a police chase while doing the Alchemy tutorial.
[*] Fixed the bug that caused Clownberry consumption effect to be permanent.
[*] Fixed the bug that caused food buff icons to display during cutscenes.
[*] Fixed the bug that caused props like bottles and pigeons to display during the fist punch animation.
[*] Fixed the bug that caused persistent highlight of building elements in the build mode.
[*] Fixed the bug that blocked you from using the alcohol skill after "flipping the bird".
[*] Fixed the bug that caused flower pots to spawn wrong items.
[*] Fixed the bug that caused flower pots to sto load incorrectly.
[*] Fixed the bug that caused flower pots to spawn plants that are much too big.
[*] Fixed the bug that blocked you from opening the skill wheel on the first try, after opening Carl's inventory.
[*] Fixed the bug that caused police to slide towards you while shooting their taser gun.
[*] Fixed the bug that let you start a Trixie subquest multiple times at once.
[*] Fixed the bug that caused the Pigeonado to spawn in the wrong place.
[*] Fixed the bug that caused pigeons to float mid-air after the pigeon coop was destroyed.
[*] Fixed the bug that caused gift boxes to float mid-air after deconstructing bum shelters.
[*] Fixed the bug that let you start the "Lady Justice" quest for the second time.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix Patch Notes Version 3.5.18.a
notes.notes:

[list]

[*] "You Can Do That!?" achievement triggers correctly now.

notes.title: Hotfix Patch Notes Version 3.5.17.a
notes.notes:
Major:
[list]
[*] The unlimited FPS option no longer caps your FPS to 60.
[*] You can now set your frame limit to 30, 60, 90, 120, 144 FPS in both the main and pause menus.
[*] Fixed a bug that was seemingly assigning the 'E' to Move Backwards input. You should now be able to remap keys as expected. 
[*] Prevent erroneous firing of the "Hide and Seek" quest after it was already finished.
[*] Clown Royale created in legacy Early Access saves will now work correctly. 
[*] Wooden Floors built by players will now spawn (and save) in the correct rotation.
[*] Fixed the bug that caused Walls and Floors to disallow disassembly.
[*] Dissasembled buildings will now correctly return materials when the recipe required 1x of the item. (previously it returned a stack of 0)
[*] Raids no longer happen on peaceful difficulty.
[*] Fixed a bug that locked the camera after drawing on cardboard in Build Mode.
[*] Added quest markers to indicate the current step required in many Main Story quests.
[*] You can now skip the entry cutscene when entering a certain warehouse.
[*] Drawing on the cardboard is now less sensitive to diagonal input when using a gamepad.
[/list]

Minor:
[list]
[*] Bum Simulator now has its own icon, instead of the Unreal Engine one.
[*] Fixed the bug that prevented the Trash Can Lids from respawning.
[*] You can no longer jump while dying.
[*] Reduced the ratio at which cars [b]honk[/b].
[*] Pigeons in cages will now correctly display the applied costume.
[*] Fixed an item duplication glitch.
[*] Raids will no longer fire during the alchemy tutorial.
[*] Reduced edge collision for player-built fences, you can now build them slightly closer to each other.
[*] Minor fixes for the shooting range quests, when entered with Shuriken skill equipped.
[*] Added a low-key audio cue to the begging input.
[*] Pigeon Lady and Mr. Jello icons on the map are now more visible.
[/list]

Other:
[list]
[*] Minor UI fixes.
[*] Minor localization and credits typo fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Bum Simulator is out now!
notes.notes:
Bum Simulator is officially out of Early Access!

What's new? 
[list]
[*]New missions that lead up to an exciting story conclusion,
[*]New Alco-Power,
[*]Many significant and minor improvements to the gameplay mechanics,
[*]Steam Achievements,
[*]Steam Badges and Trading Cards,
[*]New QoL features,
[*]Balance/Exploit fixes,
[*]Bug fixes.
[/list]

We really can’t thank everyone enough for buying, playing, bug testing, and sharing the game with friends over these past few years. Your support has made Bum Simulator the game it is today. 

If you like how the game turned out, and you want to help us out even further, then be sure to leave a review for others to see.

Note for the Early Access customers:
Your save files from the Early Access version will still work. Furthermore, when loading them, you should retroactively get all of the Achievements for the missions that you've already completed.

Note about the update:
You may want to restart Steam, just to make sure it downloads the full release update (version 3.5.09.a)

notes.title: Full Release Date!
notes.notes:
It's official. Bum Simulator will come out from early access on 
[h1]May 12th, 2023 [/h1]

The full release will introduce new story missions that will lead up to an exciting conclusion, as well as significant and minor improvements to the gameplay mechanics, balance, and Quality-of-Life features. Hopefully, that will take your bumming adventure to the next level!

We know it's been a long time coming, but your patience, understanding, and unwavering support throughout the prolonged EA period have meant the world to us. The wait is almost over, and we are excited to finally bring you the complete Bum experience.

So mark your calendars, stock up on snacks, and get ready to immerse yourself in the ultimate bum lifestyle. We can't wait to see you on the streets of Bumsville in just three weeks!

notes.title: Final Testing
notes.notes:
It’s been a while, but the game is almost ready for the full release. The story is finished, all of the new voice-acting came in, and we’re happy to announce that the game is now going through final internal testing.

We just need to squish some more bugs and add translations for the newest content.

[u]You may have noticed that there are achievements listed on the store page right now - they won’t work for you just yet, but we need them there so that we can test them internally.[/u]

The next update to the game will be the full release. We’re super happy that we're so close to finally wrapping things up and actually finishing the game for you to enjoy!

Stay tuned for the exact release date :)

notes.title: Bum Simulator is NOW AVAILABLE!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32747535/f902fd55a9f0e7c56e9d29e4d0530f62474436db.png[/img]

All good things come to an end. We hope that you enjoyed the technical beta of Bum Simulator!

Thank You all for submitting your opinions - your feedback was both helpful and inspiring. It seems we have just a handful of bugs to take care of - they shouldn't take us more than a month to fix.

The release is near :)

notes.title: Update - New Enemies
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

The development is still going strong. We just finished implementing new enemies, who make the combat more challenging during the mid and end game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32747535/6063858c8e7c885b9fde27128ed5b5b1265f238c.png[/img]

[b]Armored Bug[/b] - This armored bum can withstand a lot of beating, but his cardboard armor burns away when confronted with the fiery explosion of your Fus-Doh-Beer alchemical mixture.

[b]Bug Lord[/b] - This nasty bum can boost the combat potential of his allies and bring them back into battle after you knock them out - you must get rid of him as fast as possible.

[b]Grunts and Throwers[/b] - Instead of the basic "evil bum" enemy we initially had, we now have two separate variants - one focused on ranged attacks and one on close combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32747535/dcf0b199286c7ee3d913e7bb12e385afa67f0037.png[/img]

We have also made balance changes (especially in our hero needs), which resulted in fewer frustrations and more fun for the player. Splendid stuff!

[b]Next step:[/b] implementing leveling up and skill point systems. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Beta Results
notes.notes:
The Technical Beta is over! We got A LOT of feedback and have analyzed EVERY comment and suggestion. Thank You!

While most of the beta testers were happy with the game, we got some valuable feedback that we intend to implement. To do that, we need to move our release date to Q1 2021. We know that this might seem to be bad news to some of you, but we assure you it is necessary to create an experience that both you and we will be happy with.

notes.title: TECHNICAL BETA - ACCEPTING NOW!
notes.notes:
The game got back to us from the testing. We got rid of most of the bugs. However, we still want to test how the game behaves on different hardware - we could use YOUR help with that!

[h2]You can apply for our closed technical beta here:

Link: https://forms.gle/u51wvBFWBbfcvut4A[/h2]

The release is almost here. Help us out with this last step!

notes.title: Big News!
notes.notes:
[h2]Bum Simulator will enter Early Access soon![/h2]

We still have a lot of things that we would like to add to the project, but it is pretty obvious that you're tired of waiting.

That's why we finished a big standalone segment of the game and sent it out to our QA team for final testing. We still have to fix whatever they report, but as soon as we know how many bugs we are dealing with, we will announce the release date!

What will you get in the early access?
[list]
[*] 90% of the functionality in place,
[*] Complete Bumsville map to explore,
[*] A big chunk of the main storyline,
[*] Alcohol Alchemy with multiple craftable potions to aid you on your quest,
[*] Multiple Pigeon Skills to wreak havoc on poor civilians and your rival bum gang,
[*] Build Mode and Customization options to express yourself with,
[*] Lots of trash to rummage through in the search for food and drink.
[/list]

What will we add later?
[list]
[*] More main storyline missions,
[*] Sidequests,
[*] More Pigeon Skills,
[*] More Alchemy Potions,
[*] More enemy types,
[*] Balance adjusted to your feedback,
[*] Better optimization,
[*] ...and more!
[/list]

We are very excited to finally share our game with you, and we can't wait to hear your opinions about it!
Creating such a big and complex project was a huge challenge for our small team, but we are more than happy with the result, and we are sure that you will enjoy it as well!

Stay tuned for the release date! And in the meantime… Enjoy this clip of home base customization :)

[previewyoutube=Ei9tYAAvyyw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Still alive, and going strong
notes.notes:
Hey, we are still alive!
Sorry for being quiet for so long. As you probably noticed we have a worldwide pandemic messing stuff up left and right. 

Thankfully all of our team is in good health, but most of us have to work from home, which makes everything go slower than it should. This, paired with the upcoming release, keeps us busy and focused 100% on the development process.

The project is nearing completion, but we have to ask you for just a little bit more patience!

In the meantime enjoy some random gameplay with voice acting finally in place:
[previewyoutube=1tPL5a5Qj1Y;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Monthly News - Development Intensifies
notes.notes:
Hey there! It’s Weekly...er... Monthly News time!

Yes, we are switching to monthly news instead of weekly ones. Why? Because we need to focus all of our forces on the development if we want to keep our promise of releasing Bum Simulator in the first half of 2020.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32747535/8b9b0468a6aa6f27e575b2d12b606ecc9ebb8e5c.png[/img]

Also, the past week was focused on polishing and refining everything we have done so far, so we don't really have anything shiny and new to show you.

Although the news will be less frequent now, we will try our best to make them more substantial as we are getting nearer to the release.

notes.title: Weekly News - Year of the Rat
notes.notes:
Hey there! It’s Weekly News time!

2020 is the year of the Rat according to Chinese zodiac. What better time to show a sneak peek of the mysterious rat people? They like to call themselves Radz:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32747535/a691e9c09b22dbb3cc088c7deadca676f6bab7e4.jpg[/img]

2020 is also known as "The Year of the Bum" - that's because Bum Simulator will be released this year. We still don't have an exact release date but we will try our best to gradually narrow our estimates.

Right now it's safe to say that Bum Simulator will release in the first half of 2020.

notes.title: Weekly News - GUI Layout

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32747535/2eb21682d18f98324b3f3cebb5f736f419b5d499.jpg[/img]

We also dropped the idea of Skyrim-like compass and decided for a minimap instead. It feels much better for navigating urban areas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32747535/1fd6ba8001d48f764c3d1fd1cff5d7d964767011.jpg[/img]

We would also like to wish you all a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year! Unfortunately, due to the holiday season craze, we have to suspend the weekly news until January.

See you in 2020!

notes.notes:
Hey there! It’s Weekly News time!

We are currently adding more options to the destruction of the environment. We want to make sure that the world reacts to your mayhem accordingly.

Lack of destruction options for cars was the biggest eyesore, so we have decided to start with them:

notes.title: Weekly News - Day and Night Cycle
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32747535/935c1115436a335f0075bd8f3cd95e3278e69d61.jpg[/img]
Hey there! It’s Weekly News time!

We are currently working on the day and night cycle. The visuals are close to the final version as can be seen here:

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/LT70xOcMmXHUiOl8ID/source.gif[/img]

The shops close at night and open in the morning as you would expect. Some missions are time dependant as well.

We still need to adjust the traffic and crowd density based on the time of day and optimize the whole system for performance - hopefully, we will be able to do that before the next week's update.

See you next week!

notes.title: Weekly News - State of the Game
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32747535/6da4077d692e7a8135aaa79839af88f817430972.jpg[/img]
Hey there! It’s Weekly News time!

We decided to start a weekly announcement series to keep you all up to date. This should give you insight into the development process, as well as an opportunity to share your thoughts about the game.

Bum Simulator looks better every day, but there is still a lot to do. We need to work on the police chase mechanics, alchemy recipes, pedestrian AI, and much more, before we can call it complete!

We know that you would love to get your hands on beta as soon as possible. We would be happy to go Early Access and collect your feedback to make sure the game is balanced… BUT, it still would have to be big, self-contained, fully playable and polished game. In other words - something close to the final product. That’s why we can’t release just yet.

As for the exact release date - we don’t want to promise anything until we are 100% sure about it. You will have to wait some more, but in the meantime - enjoy the weekly news!

Today we decided to reveal one of the NPCs that you will meet in the game.
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32747535/624b264fa9b2923a62e4847737791536d76a6bcd.jpg[/img]

The Pigeon Lady - she is a quest giver, who can also sell you skill upgrades and cosmetic items for your pigeons.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32747535/8bcb54fe77b521a2394e44ae57337e64cd6a3143.jpg[/img]

She loves pigeons. Really. Take our word for it. It may be hard to notice, but it is true.

Hopefully, this update clarified the current status of the game and got you excited about the new content! See you next week!

notes.title: Bum Simulator is getting better (and delayed).
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32747535/ab5034f53791c6429d7154d8671f6a56283533b9.jpg[/img]
Bum Simulator is getting new content and features based on your suggestions! The game gets bigger and better thanks to your support! Thanks to you we are now including stuff like:
[list]
[*] day and night cycle,
[*] turning into an animal,
[*] shopping cart customization,
[*] skill tree / upgrades,
[*] pee madness,
[*] poo madness
[*] scratch offs,
[*] specific settlement locations that you can build in,
[*] playable instruments,
[*] dumpster diving (literally - leap of faith straight into trash!),
[*] minijobs.
[/list]

Unfortunately the development has been prolonged due to new map layout, some visual changes and lots of new features. This means that we need to move the release date. We're sorry that we cannot offer the game on time - however, we belive those changes are for the best.

Yours truly,
Ragged Devs
